correctness.rationale: The previous-index held controller integrates exactly to x[k+1]=x[k]-h[k]x[k-1]. Multiplying companion matrices gives F=[[1-b,-a],[1,-a]], trace 1-2m and determinant ab. Strict Jury inequalities reduce to 2m-2<ab<1; the attainable 0<ab<=m^2 gives the sharp m<3/2 mean frontier, including m=1 and m<1 boundaries. Spectral trace bound rho>=m-1/2 for m>=1 has equality only at the double negative eigenvalue, giving the uniquely determined positive unordered pair. The defective Jordan block is correctly qualified as asymptotic, not a polynomial-free finite-epoch norm. Fresh exact rational computation independently recovered F at (a,b)=(9/4,1/4), repeated -3/4 multiplier and its nilpotent Jordan remainder.
